Project summary · September 2025 – May 2026

Xyra Group: Acquisition Screening & Due Diligence

As an M&A intern, I helped assess acquisition candidates and organize diligence findings for senior review.

  • Prepared 12+ investment memos after reviewing 50+ legal and financial documents.
  • Screened businesses with £100,000+ in revenue and 35%+ gross margins using three-year financials and projections.
  • Supported a £1 million acquisition of an 80% stake by synthesizing deal findings for review and execution.

This work developed my ability to connect financial performance with diligence findings and communicate the key points of a potential investment.

Project summary · May 2026 – Present

Singh Capital Partners: Retail Acquisition Analysis

As an Investment Analyst Intern, I evaluated public and private investments for a multi-strategy platform with more than $1 billion invested in real estate assets.

  • Supported a $20.2 million acquisition involving 112,700 square feet of retail space.
  • Reviewed tenants and leases to support the investment evaluation.
  • Contributed to analysis for a transaction targeting a 20.2% IRR; this figure was a target, not a realized return.

The project gave me experience examining the tenants and lease terms behind a property's income and investment outlook.
